item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently grants the named permittees legal permission to construct, operate, and maintain the international railway tunnel; the authorization occurs through this segment itself.","evidence":"I hereby grant permission to Permittees"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The permit itself presently subjects the permittees’ facilities and operations to binding permit conditions, while reserving future termination or amendment authority.","evidence":"The United States facilities and operations herein described shall be subject to all the conditions, provisions, and requirements of this permit"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The permit presently imposes binding duties on the permittees concerning substantial changes and conformity of construction, operation, and maintenance; approval would occur before any substantial change.","evidence":"Permittees shall make no substantial change in the location of the United States facilities or in the operation authorized by this permit until such changes shall have been approved"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The permit presently imposes inspection, access, compliance, restoration, expense, and other binding conditions on the permittees, including consequences triggered upon later termination or noncompliance.","evidence":"The Permittees shall allow duly authorized officers and employees of such agencies free and unrestricted access to said facilities"},{"segment_id":"5","code":3,"rationale":"The permit itself establishes continuing permit status and presently binding rights and duties concerning possession, compensation, notice, maintenance, indemnification, authorizations, and reporting, some exercisable upon stated future contingencies.","evidence":"This permit shall continue in force and effect so long as the Permittees shall continue the operations hereby authorized"}]}
